_doc: Marksman line (spec #360, ticket MS2 #362). The second archer after Bowmaster: its job entry, its AP row and its bot card scores. Skill definitions are in skills/marksman.json; each Marksman skill ticket (MS5-MS9) appended its own region there. Marksman has NO mobility_skill (ruling D1, spec #360): a Marksman owns no skill key and no quick-slot movement cell. playable is true since MS11 #371; JobTree.default_job() stays 212 (survivor/jobs.json default_job). DataRepo discovers this per-line file automatically (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4).

322._starting_skill: tier C: spec #360: Iron Arrow : Crossbow is the starting active (slot 1) and the first skill a round learns; MS5 #365 moved its definition from skills/bowman.json into skills/marksman.json.
322._skill_pool: tier C: spec #360: the ten hand-picked Marksman actives from the 300/320/321/322 books (all auto-cast). arrow_blow is Bowmaster's shared definition (job 300). Undefined keys stay inert until their tickets define them.
322._weapon_families: tier C: spec #360: crossbows only (WeaponInfo family crossbow, 146xxxx); bows (145xxxx) belong to Bowmaster. Armour and shields drop by the Bowman class bit.
322._creation_weapon: tier A: the Crossbow (Item.wz 1462001, reqJob 4 = the Bowman bit, PAD 29; reqLevel 12 is no longer enforced, #292). Already in the Bowman manifest fragment and drop list.
322._provenance: tier C: spec #360 MS11 #371: Marksman is selectable (the QA ticket flipped it); default_job stays 212.
322._hub_kit: tier C: spec #360 MS10 #370: the --hub --job=322 test kit (HubTestKit reads it through lineage_value): the Marksman fixture (Balanche, Bowman-bit hat/shoes/gloves, tier 2), crossbow ATT 100/60/10/dark70/dark30 and the same gloves ATT, shoes ATT and hat DEX stacks as Bowmaster's kit, a spare all-job hat, a second crossbow (1462002, Lv18), Warrior-bit gloves and a Bowman-bit top, and a Lv42 crossbow (1462006) as the flow driver's diagnostic item.

322._ap: tier C: spec #360: the Bowman (300) row copied verbatim (the Bowman gear pattern, no new tuning); explicit so 322 no longer falls back through 321/320/300.

bot._card_scores: tier C: spec #360 MS10 #370: explicit learn (100) and rank (74) card scores for all ten Marksman pool skills, the numbers BotInput's pool default gives every curated skill (MS2 #362 scored the two followers, whose kind summon the default does not treat as an attack; the other eight are a guard, not a behaviour change).
